verdict.rationale: This product is an Agent Skill: a SKILL.md folder plus local Python scripts that an agent runs inside its own session. It has no hosted service, UI, or API surface, so API-vs-UI parity is a category error for this product type. The only UI-like element is a local reference gallery, which is a browsing aid for data that is also searchable from the command line, not a separate product UI with an API counterpart.
